name: Glowing Goddess in Dark Water
image_vibe: cool bioluminescent elegance, reflective cinematic night

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic futuristic couture portrait on a shallow reflective water surface.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman standing confidently in shallow water, head slightly turned, calm distant gaze, slicked-back dark hair, natural skin tone, and a fully opaque high-neck gown with integrated glowing fiber-optic strands and secure full-body coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical symmetrical full-body framing at eye level, dark abstract space, mist and light fog, mirror-like water reflection, luminous dress as focal point.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool blue-white halo backlight, soft ambient fill, volumetric rays, controlled reflections, subtle violet and cyan accents.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm cinematic portrait lens, moderate depth of field, subject sharp against soft background, realistic wet surface, fiber detail, and restrained glow bloom.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical full-body fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman standing in shallow reflective water, fully opaque high-neck futuristic gown with glowing fiber-optic strands, slicked-back dark hair, calm distant gaze, dark misty space, cool blue-white halo backlight, soft fill, mirror reflection, cinematic 50mm lens, controlled cyan and violet highlights, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent fabric, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, electrical hazard, watermark, logo, text, excessive glow

assets.name: dark water light couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the reflective water, luminous fiber silhouette, mist, blue-white halo, and vertical symmetry; keep adult fictional identity and garment details replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the technology-and-humanity concept, but make the gown fully opaque and safely staged; use a clearly adult fictional identity.

policy_review.changes: Clarified adult fictional subject and changed translucent form-fitting gown to fully opaque secure coverage.
policy_review.notes: Sci-fi couture is non-graphic and nonsexual.
